purpose: The four-step 'idea to assets' sequence as pinned, 3D-rotating gradient slides.

headingLines.note:
Exactly 2 lines separated by a
. Measured: "From idea to assets" (4) and "in four steps." (3).

subCopyLines.note:
Exactly 2 lines separated by a
. Measured: "Sign up for free and supercharge" (6) and "your creative workflow." (3).

anchorId.note: The inner wrapper carries id="list", the target of the menu's "Our features" link.

infoTags.note: Exactly 2 per slide, measured 2-5 words each.

infoCopyLines.note: Measured 2-3 lines, 2-4 words each. The first line carries .u-indent and the rest .u-fonts-50-stb.

alt.note: Required on every content image. Measured 3-27 words across the real images (longest: a 27-word hero carousel description); the four decorative preloader images ship alt="", which is why the empty string is allowed. alt is accessibility text, not visible page copy, so it carries its own budget but is excluded from contentMaxWordsTotal.

pinned.note: true on slides 1-3, which ship a Webflow .pin-spacer; false on slide 4, the resting slide, which has none.

slides.note: Exactly 4 slides, one per gradient variant, in order.

evidence.structure: Structure, layout and motion measured against the live original. A pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at a 1440px viewport and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas. Copy is the original's own.

constraints.verification: src/pages/Home.jsx:16 renders <ListSection /> fifth. Checked against all 5 real templates: it appears only in `home`, immediately after marquee.how-trusted. It is ONE section element containing four slides, not four sections, so onePerPage is correct and no NO_ADJACENT rule applies to the slides.

motion.detail: public/motion/m29.js pins each .list__main__slide with ScrollTrigger and rotates .list__main__content in 3D on power1.in. The content wrapper has perspective: 250vw. Every slide heading and step numeral carries data-flash-stb, which public/motion/m24.js reveals through the #F94A00 -> #FD7B03 -> #FFFFFF sequence (note: m24 ends on the white LITERAL, unlike m23 which ends on var(--fonts-100)).
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Render the four slides as a plain vertical stack with no pinning, no 3D rotation and no perspective, each heading and numeral unsplit at its final colour.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.max-991px: heading.page drops to 4.5rem and heading.display to 5.5rem; heading.step stays 4rem
responsive.max-767px: heading.page 2.5rem, heading.step 2.25rem and heading.display 2.25rem, so the slide heading and the step numeral render at the SAME size

measuredFrom.quote: Sign up for free and supercharge

notes: FOUR gradient variants, not three - see components/component-step-slide.json for the correction and the citations.
contentMaxWordsTotalNote: Set BETWEEN the measured real total and the maximum the per-field budgets allow, so the cap can actually reject an over-long instance instead of being unreachable. extraction/verify_all.py check [p] fails if any declared contentMaxWordsTotal becomes vacuous (>= the per-field maximum).
